The '''Klina Marches''' were a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Battle at the Klina Marches|fought]] ably at the Klina Marches, where they achieved a notable victory.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Klina Marches were first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> Jason Fry later indicated that the Klina Marches were located in the [[Klina sector/Legends|Klina sector]], but was not able to provide information about the nature of the Marches.<ref name="Fry" />
